mix.text: Hello friends, it's learning time. Let's sing about our body. Ready, let's go!
Two eyes, look, look, look. I see with my eyes I can see a book.
Two ears, listen here. I hear with my ears the bird sing near.
One nose sniff, sniff, sniff
I smell it with my nose
A flower, what a whiff
My tongue says yum, yum, yum
I tease with my tongue
A sweet mango, yum, yum
Two hands, clap, clap, clap
I touch with my hands
Soft grass in my lap
My fingers on one hand
Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle
Aren't they grand?
Eyes to see and ears to hear
Nose to smell so sweet and clear
Tongue to taste and hands to touch
I love my body very much
Wash my hands before I eat
Count to twenty, nice and neat
Brush my teeth at night, then bed
Take a bath from toes to head
Eyes to see and ears to hear
They smell so sweet and clear
Tongue to taste and hands to touch
I love my body very much
Touch your nose, touch your ears, touch your eyes, now clap and cheer
Wiggle your fingers, stamp your feet, jump up high and take a seat!
Who's time? Can you guess? Shout it out loud!
How many eyes do we have?
Two eyes! We have two eyes! What are we smelling?
Our nose!
Come and eat fingers on one hand
My fingers, my fingers on one hand
Eyes to see and ears to hear
Never smells so sweet and clear
Tongue to taste and hands to touch
I love my body very much
Find more fun worksheets and games on the website and the app!
Bye-bye friends!
